description: Committee hearings and meetings across committees (GET /v1/hearings), newest first, filterable by jurisdiction and start date. Use this to answer 'what is being heard this week' or to track when a committee next meets. Rows with has_transcript:true carry a verbatim transcript (transcript_chars long); read it with get_hearing. For hearings on one specific committee use get_committee with include:['hearings']; for one specific bill use get_bill with include:['calendar']. Floor sessions are in list_floor_transcripts.

has_transcript.description: true: only hearings with a transcript; false: only those without.

since.description: ISO-8601 date or timestamp; only hearings on or after it.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. FL), DC, or US for Congress.

name: list_hearings
title: List hearings
